* Passed
==Date==

==Cost==

==Progress==
* Landon of Longridge donated 10 Thrones to the Imperial treasury to cover the costs involved in this treaty.
==Campaign Outcome==
* In the absence of an [[ambassador]], it is the responsibility of the [[Imperial Consul]] to inform the [[Feni]] of military action.
